items.summary: Deliver portable DataTable controls and define advanced-grid ownership
items.reason: The shared scalar contract now covers Annabel's pagination and column-selection demand; rich rendering and advanced grid policy remain application-owned.

items.summary: Foundation cohort content and input affordances delivered
items.reason: Input adornments and actions plus Accordion rich item content now have portable Vue and Razor contracts.

items.summary: Display and native-form cohort maturity delivered
items.reason: Switch now supports trusted custom thumb content in Vue and Razor while retaining native form semantics.

items.summary: Navigation and overlay composition maturity delivered
items.reason: Owned semantic triggers, panels, modal regions, rich collection content, and explicit superseded boundaries now have Vue and Razor evidence.
Localized clear actions and typed asynchronous command states now preserve native submission, trusted content, and progressive-enhancement boundaries in Vue and Razor.

items.summary: Layout primitives and shell ownership verified
items.reason: The Razor page verifies Container and Stack, the Vue consumers verify primitive composition, and each application retains its shell policy.
Published manifests, migration guidance, machine maturity gates, documentation, and examples now agree before Phase 18 expansion.
Fieldset, IconButton, ProgressBar, and ProgressSpinner advance to implementation; the showcase-only Tag is superseded by Badge.
Static subsets compose from native semantics and existing primitives; behavior-rich navigation, workflow, discovery, and chooser policy remain application-owned without shared Razor demand.
Fieldset, IconButton, ProgressBar, and ProgressSpinner now have complete contracts, CSS, Vue, Razor, parity, documentation, and showcase evidence.
Nine executable Vue recipes with equivalent Razor guidance now preserve the portable composition while explicitly assigning shell, async, theme, and lifecycle policy to applications.
The four reconsideration criteria remain unmet: consumers need different landmarks, navigation, persistence, and workflow policy, and the real Razor consumer has no matching shell demand.

items.summary: Remove the playground legacy design-system dependencies
items.reason: This is the concrete consumer exit condition after required component and recipe work lands.

items.summary: Run complete package, parity, and real-consumer verification
items.reason: Migration completion requires both adapters and both representative consumers to pass together.

items.summary: Publish the matured cohort and exact migration notes
items.reason: Release only verified shared changes while leaving retained VueForge products available.
